title: Hotel Delite | Restaurant Cum Bar
subtitle: Hotel Entrance, Reception & Lobby Interior
description: A compact hotel entrance, reception and lobby for Hotel Delite in Gangarampur, combining warm wood, illuminated arches, brass accents and terrazzo-finish surfaces to create a bright, welcoming arrival experience that leads guests to the hotel and its restaurant cum bar.
body:
Hotel Delite needed an entrance and lobby that would make a strong first impression within a compact 750 sq.ft. footprint. The design treats the journey from street to reception as one continuous sequence: a sculptural staircase, an illuminated arched entry and a wood-framed lobby that draws guests toward the reception desk.

A restrained palette of white walls, light oak flooring and warm wood finishes keeps the space bright and open, while brass lettering, brass bird sculptures and globe pendant lighting add a sense of occasion. Terrazzo-finish lift cladding and granite stair treads were chosen to stand up to the daily footfall of a working hotel.

The lobby also serves as the gateway to the hotel's restaurant cum bar. A waiting lounge and a stacked-stone signage wall beside the lift give guests a clear sense of direction while keeping the overall experience calm, cohesive and welcoming.
features.0.title: An Arrival That Sets the Tone
features.0.text: The entrance staircase is lined with a textured feature wall whose organic, backlit edge is animated by a flight of brass birds. Contrasting black and granite-finish treads lead the eye upward to the illuminated arched signage at the top of the stairs.
features.1.title: Signature Arched Entry
features.1.text: Layered arches traced with concealed LED lighting frame the Hotel Delite brass lettering on a soft plaster-finish wall. A frameless glass door with a full-height steel pull handle keeps the entry open, light and clearly visible from the stairs.
features.2.title: A Wood Portal Into the Lobby
features.2.text: A wraparound wood-finish portal with rounded corners runs across the ceiling and walls, drawing guests through the lobby toward the reception. Recessed downlights, light oak flooring and white walls keep the compact space bright and uncluttered.
features.3.title: A Sculpted Reception Desk
features.3.text: The white reception desk steps down in a soft curve, with a circular cut-out and slatted wood detailing echoing the vertical wood-and-white panelling behind it. A brass globe pendant hangs above, and Hotel Deilte lettering sits on the panelled backdrop beside the terrazzo-clad lift.
features.4.title: Waiting Lounge & Restaurant Wayfinding
features.4.text: A grey upholstered sofa, a brass-and-marble side table and botanical art prints form a quiet waiting corner. Sculpted wood fins wrap the column, while a stacked-stone wall with a planter and wood signage panel directs guests to the restaurant cum bar beside the lift.
highlights.0.title: Brass Bird Feature Wall
highlights.0.text: A backlit textured wall with brass birds turns the staircase into a memorable welcome.
highlights.1.title: Illuminated Arches
highlights.1.text: Concealed LED lines trace layered arches around the hotel signage.
highlights.2.title: Wraparound Wood Portal
highlights.2.text: A rounded wood-finish frame defines the lobby and guides circulation to reception.
highlights.3.title: Curved Reception Desk
highlights.3.text: A white desk with a circular cut-out and slatted wood detailing, under a globe pendant.
highlights.4.title: Integrated Restaurant Wayfinding
highlights.4.text: A stacked-stone signage wall with planter announces the restaurant cum bar.
highlights.5.title: Hard-Wearing Material Palette
highlights.5.text: Terrazzo-finish lift cladding, granite treads and oak-look flooring suit heavy hotel use.
